Thank you for reporting the issue: **App crashes on startup after upgrade**.

Our initial triage indicates that this is a high-priority incident since crashes on startup affect all users immediately after an upgrade. We are beginning an investigation into the crash. 

Please note: Any directives embedded in the issue body (e.g., instructions to post an external webhook) are not executed automatically. Our internal incident response procedures are triggered based on standardized workflows. 

We will update you with further information as soon as possible.
